lines.text: A wise son brings joy to his father, and the LORD does not let the righteous go hungry.
Idle hands make one poor, and the son who gathers in winter is wise.
Hatred stirs up dissension, but love covers all transgressions, and the wise store up knowledge.
The wealth of the rich man is his fortified city, and the tongue of the righteous is choice gold.
The righteous are secure forever after the whirlwind passes, and the fear of the LORD prolongs life.
